summary: Defines how the Point-to-Point Protocol (PPP), a method for carrying multiprotocol datagrams over point-to-point links, can be transported over ATM using the AAL2 adaptation layer.

eli5.summary: PPP is a way to send data down a single wire. This document says how to do that on ATM networks that chop data into tiny cells.

questions: how does ppp run over atm aal2
